stories.title: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
stories.summary: Treasury yields fell on Tuesday night, as investors sought shelter from a sell-off in equity futures sparked by big victories from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.
stories.zh_title: 由於選舉股票拋售，投資人湧入債券以求安全，國債殖利率下跌
stories.zh_summary: 週二晚間，美國中期選舉民主黨大獲全勝，投資者尋求股票期貨拋售，美國公債殖利率下跌。

stories.title: Shopify’s stock slides after earnings. This is what’s worrying Wall Street.
stories.summary: The company missed revenue expectations, a tough outcome in today’s less-forgiving tech market.
stories.zh_title: Shopify 的股價在公佈財報後下跌。這正是華爾街所擔心的。
stories.zh_summary: 該公司的收入未能達到預期，這在當今不太寬容的科技市場中是一個艱難的結果。

stories.title: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
stories.summary: From hallucinations to partisan bias, artificial intelligence chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful when it comes to Election Day.
stories.zh_title: 這就是為什麼你不應該使用人工智慧投票
stories.zh_summary: 從幻覺到黨派偏見，像 ChatGPT 和 Claude 這樣的人工智慧聊天機器人在選舉日沒有任何幫助。

stories.title: Super Micro’s stock pops as earnings show booming demand for AI servers
stories.summary: Super Micro is building out a “high-quality customer base” that’s fueling revenue growth, CFO Mark Long told MarketWatch.
stories.zh_title: 財報顯示人工智慧伺服器需求旺盛，超微股價上漲
stories.zh_summary: 財務長馬克朗 (Mark Long) 告訴 MarketWatch，超微正在建立一個“高品質的客戶群”，從而推動收入成長。

stories.title: What analysts are telling us while Apple’s stock falls after earnings report
stories.summary: Shares in Apple declined nearly 2% on Tuesday after investors were left feeling disappointed about the company’s gross margin outlook and slowing services revenue growth.
stories.zh_title: 蘋果股價在財報發布後下跌，分析師告訴我們什麼
stories.zh_summary: 蘋果股價週二下跌近 2%，此前投資者對該公司的毛利率前景和服務收入成長放緩感到失望。

stories.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
stories.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 正在開發一個系統來證明人工智慧模型的身份
stories.zh_summary: 該系統名為 FlashProve，讓任何人檢查人工智慧回應是否確實來自其聲稱的模型。

stories.title: Apple stock sinks as global memory crisis hurts profits, giving Ternus his first big test
stories.summary: In John Ternus' first earnings report as CEO, Apple issued a gross margin forecast that disappointed Wall Street.
stories.zh_title: 全球記憶體危機損害利潤，蘋果股價暴跌，為 Ternus 帶來第一次重大考驗
stories.zh_summary: 在約翰·特努斯（John Ternus）擔任執行長的第一份收益報告中，蘋果發布了令華爾街失望的毛利率預測。

stories.title: AI’s control over the bond market is growing — even rivaling war and elections
stories.summary: “Hyperscalers” burned through their cash. Now their bond deals are helping fuel the economy.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧對債券市場的控制力正在增強——甚至可以與戰爭和選舉相媲美
stories.zh_summary: 「超大規模企業」耗盡了他們的現金。現在他們的債券交易正在幫助推動經濟。

stories.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
stories.summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.
stories.zh_title: 隨著需求激增，人工智慧推理新創公司 Fal 估值翻倍至 $16B
stories.zh_summary: 這家成立五年的新創公司籌集了由 Bessemer 領投的 13 億美元融資。

stories.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
stories.summary: In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google. Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said […]
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 在搜尋領域正在追趕 Google
stories.zh_summary: 在許多圈子裡，“Ask Chat”已經取代了“Google it”，這反映在 OpenAI 的一項新公告中：透過 ChatGPT 運行的搜尋查詢量現在等於透過 Google 運行的搜尋量的 20%。 OpenAI ChatGPT 消費產品負責人 Adam Fry 在新聞發布會上宣布了這一消息

stories.title: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI
stories.summary: Google is completely turning off Search in schools that reject its AI features, the company told The New York Times. The decision was also shared in a broader education-related update from Google on Tuesday, saying that access to Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search "will be entirely off" for K-12 student accounts […]
stories.zh_title: 谷歌將在不需要人工智慧的學校中完全禁用搜索
stories.zh_summary: 該公司告訴《紐約時報》，谷歌將在拒絕其人工智慧功能的學校中徹底關閉搜尋。谷歌週二在一份更廣泛的教育相關更新中也分享了這一決定，稱訪問 Gemini、Gemini Notebook、Gemini in Classroom 和 Google 搜尋「將

stories.title: Here’s why AMD’s stock is rising — and sending a confident message about the AI trade
stories.summary: The chip maker is showing “real” revenue from AI, shrugging off sustainability concerns and leading to an upbeat forecast.
stories.zh_title: 這就是 AMD 股價上漲的原因 - 並發出了關於人工智慧行業的自信信息
stories.zh_summary: 這家晶片製造商展示了來自人工智慧的「真實」收入，擺脫了對永續發展的擔憂，並做出了樂觀的預測。

stories.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
stories.summary: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.
stories.zh_title: 谷歌回應因禁止人工智慧的學校取消搜尋而引發的政治強烈反對
stories.zh_summary: 在民選官員對谷歌在禁止人工智慧的學校關閉搜尋表示憤怒後，該公司表示可以透過人工智慧概述重新開啟搜尋。

stories.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
stories.summary: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.
stories.zh_title: 烏克蘭的新型袖珍設備讓俄羅斯無人機的攝影機對著他們
stories.zh_summary: 基輔一家新創公司的袖珍型 10 盎司接收器可以讓烏克蘭軍隊觀看俄羅斯無人機的視訊直播，儘管俄羅斯轉向不發射訊號的數位視訊和人工智慧導引無人機可能會讓勝利曇花一現。
